texts.zh:
我们从[subject_empire.GetName]被占领的殖民地收到了一封通讯，行文措辞如同现在他们整个国家一般支离破碎。我们的附属国无法自保，正在寻求我们的帮助。

由于我们的外交协议所具有的军国主义性质，我们自然应当涉足其中，并保护我们的附属国不受到进一步的伤害。我们的一些顾问则考虑，也许通过鼓舞我们的附庸让他们奋起保卫自己而不是直接介入，才是对双方更合适的决定。
texts.en:
We have received reports from the occupied colonies of [subject_empire.GetName], disorganized and destitute as they currently are. Our subject is now looking to us for aid, as they seem unable to defend themselves.

Considering the militaristic nature of our diplomatic agreement, it would be only natural for us to step in and protect them from further harm. Some of our advisors wonder if we all might be better served by inspiring our vassal to rise up and defend themselves, rather than by intervening directly.

label.zh: 我们鼓励他们保卫自己。
label.en: We will inspire them to defend themselves.

tooltips.zh: [subject_empire.GetName]可能会变得更军国主义一些。

label.zh: 无论如何，保护附庸是宗主的职责。
label.en: It is an overlord's duty to protect their vassal, no matter what.

label.zh: 他们要学会自力更生了。
label.en: They are on their own, for now.

texts.zh:
我们人民遭受的苦难还在继续，许多人开始寄希望于我们的宗主[overlord_empire.GetName]能提供点帮助。他们已经长期向我们索取了很多，如今只有他们涉足战争，从外辱中解救我们的人民才公平。

在公开求助之后，我们终于从宗主那获得了一些外派军事顾问，他们会来帮助我们的人民重新夺回领土。他们已经开始讨论我们能如何更好地在军事上利用我们的人民，尽管这也要付出相应的代价。
texts.en:
As the mistreatment of our people continues, many are looking to our overlord, [overlord_empire.GetName], for potential aid. They have long demanded much of us, and it seems only fair that they would step in now that our people are suffering under foreign occupation.

After a public outcry, we have finally received some military advisors from our overlord, who has stepped in to help us prepare our own people to retake our territory. They have started discussing ways in which we can utilize our people better militarily, though it will come at certain costs.

texts.zh:
由于我们殖民地遭受的苦难还在继续，我们开始寄希望于宗主[overlord_empire.GetName]能提供点帮助。他们已经长期向我们索取了很多，如今只有他们涉足战争，从外辱中解救我们才公平。

在派出若干无人机进行求助之后，我们终于从宗主那获得了一些外派军事顾问，他们会来帮助组织我们重新夺回领土。考虑到我们最初对我们宗主的期望，这个结果差强人意，而且我们还将无法按原计划调用我们的资源。
texts.en:
As the mistreatment of our colonies continues, we have started looking to our [overlord_empire.GetName] for aid. They have long demanded much of us, and it seems only fair that they would step in now that we are suffering under foreign occupation.

After sending several drones to request some sort of aid, we finally receive some military advisors that will look into helping us reorganizing our assets so we are better prepared to retake our areas on our own. A small disappointment, considering what we originally wanted from our overlord, particularly as we will not be able to use our resources as originally planned.

texts.zh:
我们人民遭受的苦难还在继续，许多人开始寄希望于我们的宗主[overlord_empire.GetName]能提供点帮助。他们已经长期向我们索取了很多，如今只有他们涉足战争，从外辱中解救我们的人民才公平。

在公开求助之后，我们终于从宗主那获得了一些外派军事[overlord_empire.GetIndividualName]，他们会来帮助我们的人民重新夺回领土。似乎我们的宗主认为，最好还是由我们自己组织我们的人民来光复失地，而不应该寄希望于他们涉身其中手把手帮我们。
texts.en:
As the mistreatment of our people continues, many are looking to our overlord, [overlord_empire.GetName], for potential aid. They have long demanded much of us, and it seems only fair that they would step in now that our people are suffering under foreign occupation.

After a public outcry, we have finally received a military [overlord_empire.GetIndividualName] from our overlord, who has calmly reorganized our people and prepared them to retake our lands. It seems our overlord believes it would be better if we organized our population to retake our own colonies, rather than expecting a caretaker to step in and do it for us.

texts.zh:
由于我们殖民地遭受的苦难还在继续，我们开始寄希望于宗主[overlord_empire.GetName]能提供点帮助。他们已经长期向我们索取了很多，如今只有他们涉足战争，从外辱中解救我们才公平。

在公开求助之后，我们终于从宗主那获得了一些外派军事[overlord_empire.GetIndividualName]，他们会来帮助我们组织资源重新夺回领土。似乎我们的宗主认为，最好还是由我们自己重新组织并光复失地，而不应该寄希望于他们涉身其中手把手帮我们。
texts.en:
As the mistreatment of our colonies continues, we have started looking to our [overlord_empire.GetName] for aid. They have long demanded much of us, and it seems only fair that they would step in now that we are suffering under foreign occupation.

After sending messengers to request some sort of aid we finally received a military [overlord_empire.GetIndividualName] from our overlord, who has calmly reorganized our assets and prepared them to retake our lands. It seems our overlord believes it would be better if we organized and liberated our own colonies, rather than expecting a caretaker to step in and do it for us.

label.zh: 夺回自由，不惜一切代价。
label.en: Freedom from occupation is worth any cost.
Even freedom is not worth what they suggest.

texts.zh: 整个[subject_empire.GetName]的人们众志成城，决心驱逐外辱，奋起捍卫他们的家园，时刻准备着为帝国奉献自己。希望这能够解决我们附庸遭遇到的问题。
texts.en: All across [subject_empire.GetName] the people have come together to defend their homes from foreign occupation, readily serving their empire. Hopefully this will be the beginning of the end for the problems afflicting our vassal.

texts.zh: 即使遭受占领，[subject_empire.GetName]的人民仍拒绝任何夺回领土的尝试。
texts.en: Even under occupation, the people of [subject_empire.GetName] have rejected any attempts to help them retake their territory.
